_comment: B3 bypass_cat (Phase 4.2 L2 主推荐): cell_bypass_mode='cat', 双通道显式并行 cell_repr = cat([bypass (256), attended (256)]) = 512. fusion_dim = 512+128+64 = 704 (不严格兼容 Phase 6 ckpt, 走全新 init). 不依赖 modulation 强度, 让 MLP 自己决定何时依赖 bypass / 何时依赖 attended. pretrain_ckpt=null + lr_encoder=1e-4 (承自 A4 最佳起点). 预期 LODO 0.78-0.82 (更接近 baseline). 详见 [Phase4.2架构改造规划.md] §5.3
